description: This file contains the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache, which implements methods for managing cache validation, updating, sanitization, and writing cache content within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache
classes.description: Class providing methods for cache validation, updating, sanitization, and writing in Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: cacheModifiedCheck
methods.description: Checks if the client-side cache has been modified.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache by rendering from the compiled template and writing to cache.

methods.name: removeNoCacheHash
methods.description: Sanitizes content and manages cache hashes, removing no-cache parts.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes sanitized content to the cache resource.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes cache object to handler, updating cache metadata.
